title: Describing Abilities and Remarkable Features
summary: Talking about what is special or noteworthy and giving feedback.
whyItMatters: An engaging factual description gives orientation, explains why a feature matters, supports remarkable claims, and responds constructively to questions or feedback.

mentalModel.title: Fact, function, significance
mentalModel.content: State the feature, explain what it enables, and show why it is noteworthy.

mentalModel.title: Feedback improves precision
mentalModel.content: React by identifying what was clear, what needs evidence, and what question remains.

ruleBlocks.title: Introduce the animal and context
ruleBlocks.content: Name species, habitat, and the feature you will focus on.

ruleBlocks.title: Connect ability to mechanism
ruleBlocks.content: Use dadurch, indem, ermöglichen, and dienen to explain how it works.

ruleBlocks.title: Support comparisons and records
ruleBlocks.content: Give units, conditions, and an appropriate comparison.

ruleBlocks.title: Give specific feedback
ruleBlocks.content: Praise a clear point, ask for clarification, or suggest missing evidence.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Diese Eigenschaft ermöglicht es dem Tier, ...
Klar erklärt war ..., noch genauer könnte ... sein.

examples.de: Besonders bemerkenswert ist, dass Krähen Werkzeuge herstellen können.
examples.en: It is particularly remarkable that crows can make tools.

examples.de: Diese Fähigkeit ermöglicht es ihnen, Nahrung aus schwer erreichbaren Stellen zu holen.
examples.en: This ability enables them to retrieve food from difficult places.

examples.de: Klar erklärt war die Funktion des Schnabels; die Größenangabe braucht noch eine Quelle.
examples.en: The function of the beak was clearly explained; the size figure still needs a source.

commonMistakes.correct: Name the exact ability and evidence.
commonMistakes.reason: Specific information creates interest and credibility.

commonMistakes.correct: Identify one strength and one actionable improvement.
